board-empty: No scores for this day yet.
board-empty-friends: None of your friends have a score for this day yet.
entry-desc: One passage a day for everyone, one scored attempt and a daily leaderboard.
missed-note: The attempt was not finished within 15 minutes, so it has no score. You can still practice the passage.
practice-note: Practice run. It is not scored and not on the board.
ready-note: Start uses today’s one scored attempt and begins the clock. You have 15 minutes. The text is shown once you start.
rejected-note: Your result was rejected as implausible, so this attempt has no score and cannot be retried. You can still practice the passage.
running-note: Your attempt is running. If you reload, the clock keeps going and the text is shown again.
title: Daily challenge
